formats.name: Textured Canvas
formats.summary: One acrylic canvas with texture paste and palette knives, 30x40cm, from a guided monthly theme. Beginner-friendly; take it home the same day.

formats.name: Acrylic Canvas
formats.summary: One brush-on acrylic canvas, 30x40cm, from a guided theme. The easiest format for a first visit.

formats.name: Watercolour Botanicals
formats.summary: Two A5 botanical studies on cotton paper, one mounted in a card frame.

formats.name: Plant-based Bake Lab
formats.summary: One plant-based bake, boxed to take home. A familiar bread most weeks (focaccia, pizza dough, cinnamon rolls, bagels, milk bread); specialty breads and cakes at RM85.

formats.name: Sing Your Song
formats.summary: A recorded group performance of one song plus a short solo technique round; the recording is sent to you.

formats.name: Reels for Your Business
formats.summary: Three short vertical videos of your product, dish or service, shot and edited on your phone, posted before you leave.

formats.name: Phone Photography Walk + Edit
formats.summary: A six-image edited set, shot on your phone on a short walk around Sri Hartamas and edited back at the studio.
